api_url.description: Full HTTPS URL of Nutanix Prism Element or Prism Central (e.g., https://10.0.0.1). Required.

username.description: Username with cluster admin or appropriate privilege to perform VM fencing (e.g., admin@local). Required.

password.description: Password for the specified username. Stored in plaintext in config — secure via filesystem permissions.

domain.description: Authentication domain (e.g., 'local', 'ad.example.com'). Typically 'local' for built-in users.

verify_ssl.description: Enable strict SSL certificate validation. Disable only in lab/test environments with self-signed certs.

ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to custom CA certificate file for self-signed or internal PKI. Leave empty to use system trust store.

api_version.description: Explicit API version (e.g., 'v2.0' or 'v3'). If left blank, the agent auto-detects the version.

retry_count.description: Number of retry attempts for failed API calls before marking the fence operation as failed.

retry_sleep.description: Seconds to wait between retry attempts. Minimum 1; higher values reduce load during transient outages.

timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a single fencing action (e.g., VM power-off) to complete.

mode.description: Connection mode: 'native' for Prism Element, or 'prism_central' for centralized management across clusters.

cluster_uuid.description: UUID of the target cluster when using Prism Central mode. Required for multi-cluster environments.

port.description: Custom port for Prism API. 0 means auto-select based on URL scheme (443 → 9443, 80 → 9440).

metadata_tags.description: Optional list of string tags to attach to fence operations for debugging or audit logging.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logs generated by the fence agent. Use 'debug' only when troubleshooting.
